summary: This plugin customizes DeepSeek Harness right-click behavior in workspace/session UI, blank areas, and editable text zones to provide direct action menus such as create, rename, fork, archive, and text edit/search commands.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This is a user-facing UI interaction plugin that customizes right-click behavior in the DeepSeek Harness workspace UI to provide context actions for workspace/session rows, blank-area menus, and text-edit areas, while delegating actions through host APIs. The evidence is explicit about menu replacement and available operations, so the classification is navigation-focused UI enhancement with moderate risk due to user-triggered rename/delete/archive actions and host integration paths.
